fieldValues.title: Add block
fieldValues.summary: Add a block of any type the site offers, after the selected block or at the end.
fieldValues.explanation: The site's package decides which block types a page can hold (its site Composition dispatches each to a View). Add block lists them; a new block starts empty, with a key of its own.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Suggest the block type that matches what the writer wants to say; never invent a type the menu does not list.
